overall: The AG found a selectboard member's email giving opinions to a quorum violated the Open Meeting Law, but the Board had already disclosed and read the email publicly, so no additional relief was ordered and the matter was closed by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that an email listing pros and cons of a licensing matter, sent to all board members, amounted to deliberation outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the email at issue here contained language that reasonably could have been interpreted as an expression of opinion from one member of the Board to a quorum in violation of the Law.
